wiki.title: Trish Ranson
wiki.extract: Trish Ranson (born November 23, 1969) is an American politician who has served in the Oklahoma House of Representatives from the 34th district since 2018. She was reelected in 2020, 2022, and in 2024. A former educator, Ranson is a member of the Democratic Party.
